instruction: Mark all emails in the Bills folder as read

rules.sql: select (select count(*) from messages where folderID = 13) = (select count(*) from messageAttributes where attributeID = 56 and value = 1 and messageID in (select id from messages where folderID = 13));

metadata.explanation: Task requires marking all emails in the Bills folder (folderID=13) as read. The evaluator checks if ALL emails in folder 13 have the read attribute (attributeID=56) set to 1 by comparing the total count of emails in the folder with the count of read emails. This is verified via SQL query on the Thunderbird global-messages-db.sqlite database.

llm_judge_reasons: SQL query correctly compares total email count in folder 13 with count of read emails: '(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages WHERE folderID=13) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messageAttributes WHERE attributeID=56 AND value=1 AND messageID IN (SELECT id FROM messages WHERE folderID=13))'
Evaluator properly verifies ALL emails are marked as read, not just some emails
Complete coverage: The logic ensures every email in the Bills folder has the read attribute set
Getter correctly fetches Thunderbird's SQLite database after closing the application to ensure data is flushed
Postconfig appropriately closes Thunderbird window and waits 1.5s for database commit
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor suggestion: If runtime testing reveals database write timing issues, consider increasing postconfig sleep from 1.5s to 2.0s for more conservative timing
